description: A live token playground for the Svelte 5 data grid. Sliders and colour pickers write --sg-accent, --sg-bg, --sg-header-bg, --sg-border and --sg-radius, choose the font family, switch dark and light through the data-theme attribute and set density through rowHeight, and the grid restyles in real time. A Copy CSS pane emits the full :root snippet to paste into a stylesheet, and the settings persist in localStorage across reloads.

faq.question: How is the grid styled?
faq.answer: Entirely through --sg-* custom properties. Set them on any wrapper element and every grid inside picks them up; the studio writes them on its wrapper as you move the controls.

faq.question: How do I switch to dark mode?
faq.answer: Set data-theme='dark' on a wrapper or on <html>. The theme stylesheets define a dark token set under that attribute, so the switch is one attribute change.

faq.question: Is there a shortcut for density?
faq.answer: rowHeight is a grid prop, so pass 28 for compact or 44 for comfortable; padding tokens follow the row height in the built-in themes.
